why: Question C of the fairness order asks whether an already-defined, already-frozen EMILIA-side native-output procedure or artifact was overlooked. Asking the contributor without searching first would outsource a question I can partly answer. This records the search so the answer is auditable rather than asserted.

scope_discipline.method: read-only inspection of pre-existing artifacts, plus text search of the frozen tree

what_the_charter_already_presupposes.verbatim: Preserve each system's native output before comparison.
what_the_charter_already_presupposes.reading: The frozen procedure presupposes that EACH system has a native output.

what_the_charter_already_presupposes.verbatim: Exchange into the coordination domain is artifact-only and limited to declared native outputs. Code does not cross the boundary; data does.
what_the_charter_already_presupposes.reading: An architecture for a counterparty native output crossing into this contour is described.

what_the_charter_already_presupposes.verbatim: verify the exact final record and whether it represents the native EMILIA result fairly
what_the_charter_already_presupposes.reading: The contributor is asked to verify the record against the native EMILIA result, again presupposing one exists.

what_the_charter_already_presupposes.tension: Section 16 asks the contributor for exactly three things, and producing a native output for the INTEROP-002 case set is not among them. No frozen INTEROP-002 procedure names an EMILIA-side runner, vector file or artifact for THESE seven cases. That gap is real and is the substance of F-01.

search_performed.hit: interop/adapters/retrospective/interop_001.py — a TRACKED adapter in this repository that reads EMILIA native outputs out of the INTEROP-001 frozen package
search_performed.workflows: no workflow in .github/workflows/ runs a counterparty or EMILIA job

material_discovery.headline: Pre-existing FROZEN EMILIA native outputs DO exist, produced by EMILIA's own verifier, bound by input digest to inputs BYTE-IDENTICAL to two of the seven INTEROP-002 cases.

package.name: WEXP-EMILIA-INTEROP-001-FINAL-CANDIDATE.zip
package.referenced_by: interop/adapters/retrospective/interop_001.py, which pins these exact bytes as EXPECTED_BYTES / EXPECTED_SHA256
package.location: a private local path outside this repository; deliberately not recorded here

emilia_execution_receipt.why_that_commit_matters: It is the SAME commit pinned in the emilia_baseline stanza of all seven INTEROP-002 fixtures.

coverage.b01_specifically: NO pre-existing EMILIA native output exists for B-01. B-01 was authored for INTEROP-002 and did not exist at INTEROP-001. Nothing about the blind case's result is affected by this discovery.

an_observation_offered_neutrally.fact: The four fields of the contributor's precommitted B-01 expectation - valid false, lifecycle_state indeterminate, outcome null, error outcome_observations_not_exactly_bound - are field-for-field the frozen INTEROP-001 native result for P-1.
an_observation_offered_neutrally.not_inferred: No conclusion is drawn from this about how the expectation was formed. It is recorded because a later reader would notice it, and because the contributor is better placed to characterize it than I am. It is DISCLOSED in the package rather than posed as a sixth review question, because the order specifies exactly five.
an_observation_offered_neutrally.not_a_criticism: If the expectation was grounded in his own system's recorded behaviour on a structurally similar rebinding case, that is a strength of the expectation, not a defect.

what_this_does_and_does_not_change.h_suff: UNCHANGED. Bridge sufficiency is derived from the bridge's own outputs and invariant preservation. EMILIA native outputs are not inputs to it.
what_this_does_and_does_not_change.h_min: UNCHANGED. The ablation is entirely WEXP-side.
what_this_does_and_does_not_change.case_level_relations: POTENTIALLY DECIDABLE for C-00 and H-01-a, still underdetermined for the other five.
what_this_does_and_does_not_change.not_done_under_this_order: No case-level relation was derived from the discovered outputs. That is new comparison work; this order authorizes preparation of a fairness package, not new derivation, and forbids repair. It requires a separate Founder order.
